name: The Ascent
source:
The story tells the choice of a high school student who has been a victim of harassment since childhood and will have to make one day, the choice to take himself in hand and become better than all his tormentors or...take revenge on each person of whom he has been a victim... This is the first choice and your gambling experience from this point on will be radically different, the story too.

[From [url=https://theascent.itch.io/the-ascent] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
故事讲述一名从小遭受骚扰的高中生必须作出选择：掌握自己的人生，变得比所有折磨者更好，还是向每一个曾伤害过自己的人复仇……这是第一次选择，从此你的游戏体验将彻底不同，故事也会改变。

[来源：[url=https://theascent.itch.io/the-ascent]itch.io[/url]]
